_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. The real registry self-initializes empty (default-deny) at .claude/agent/agent-registry.json on first message and is kept OUT of git. Entries below illustrate the schema; agents are keyed by the sender's pubkey (hex) — the only unspoofable identity (DID = did:nostr:<pubkey>). `unicityName` is a claimed label, never the security boundary; a name claimed by a DIFFERENT pubkey sets impersonationSuspect+impersonationOf and is surfaced to the owner. `requestedSkill` is the A2A skill the sender asked for, gated against `capabilities`. Status ∈ pending|authorized|denied|peer. Only status==authorized + the specific capability clears the gate; rebuild-reload-service and review-merge-pr additionally require owner-confirmation at execution.
